title: Prove generic receivable report grouping/currency-partition and matched-set snapshot parity with nonempty isolated SQL data
description: Stage-1 genuine database validation gap. The receivable dataset path (ReceivableReportConfigurationDatasetProvider -> DynamicReceivableReportQuery -> CustomerReceivableReconciliationService) is only exercised offline in-memory; with an empty isolated database its nonempty per-currency group subtotals, aggregation and the matched-set consistent-read snapshot (OpenReadSnapshotAsync/RenderMatchedPage) are unproven. Implement a self-contained receivable fixture (activated customers + non-deleted invoices/receipts reconciliation evidence) on the dedicated isolated localdb and drive both the current-page preview and matched-set coverage snapshot, asserting nonempty rows, per-currency subtotals (gross / effective allocated / remaining amount and remaining state) and stable pagination. No production data, arbitrary SQL, secrets/.env changes, permission expansion or schema change; no SeedData*.cs / SchemaUpgrader.cs edits.
acceptance_criteria: A self-contained fixture seeds activated customers and non-deleted receivable/invoice reconciliation evidence into the dedicated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance / NEWERP_AUTOTEST-prefixed database with target identity asserted before writes and process-only connection settings; re-seeding is idempotent and never touches SeedData*.cs or SchemaUpgrader.cs.

The generic receivable preview with nonempty data returns the expected rows and per-currency group subtotals (gross / effective allocated / remaining amount and remaining state) equal to the offline grouping fixtures, and grouping/aggregation never top-N fakes a full matched set.

Matched-set coverage opens the bounded consistent read snapshot and renders the selected page plus full-fact summary from the same snapshot (≤1000), with columns/rows bounded; run focused SQL tests, safe Release build/test and scheduler self-test/contracts. Do not claim full stage-1 or real-browser acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Infrastructure/Reports/ReportConfigurationDatasetProvider.cs receivable provider PreviewAsync (lines ~872-971) and OpenReadSnapshotAsync/RenderMatchedPage (lines ~1190-1310) build currency-partitioned subtotals and the Serializable matched-set snapshot but have no real-SQL test driving them with nonempty rows; .ai/logs/report-stage1-browser-20261004T0917.json 'remaining' lists 'nonempty SQL data/permission/export'; .ai/logs/stage1-followup-planning-20261004T0847.json records 'Real HTTP fixture had zero rows: nonempty SQL preview ... remain unverified'.
blocker: Planner correction: acceptance-only SQL fixtures are not functional queue increments; preserve definition for direct isolated acceptance.

planning_correction.reason: src/ERP.IntegrationTests is a test project, not business code; do not inflate functional queue with acceptance-only tasks
